# Misael Olivares — Digital Marketing Portfolio

> Vancouver-based digital marketer and former professional cook (8+ years in kitchens). Focus: restaurant, food and hospitality marketing. Studying the Diploma in Digital Marketing Professional at Greystone College.

## Case studies
- [Kaizen Cantina: Mexican–Japanese Restaurant Brand Concept](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/kaizen-cantina-restaurant-brand-concept): Create a distinctive restaurant concept for premium urban diners.
- [El Molino: Modern Mexican Tortillería Brand and Launch Campaign](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/el-molino-tortilleria-launch-campaign): Build awareness and generate pre-launch interest for a new restaurant concept.
- [MeltnBite: Social Media and Paid Campaign for a Vancouver Brownie Brand](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/meltnbite-social-paid-campaign): Increase awareness and engagement for a new dessert brand in a competitive local market.
- [MeltnBite Instagram Campaign: 10-Day Social Media Growth Campaign](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/meltnbite-instagram-growth-campaign): Grow an emerging dessert brand’s Instagram presence within a short, measurable window.
- [Party Tray Paradise: Vancouver Party Tray Marketplace](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/party-tray-paradise-analytics-dashboard): Connect customers with affordable, multicultural party trays from local Vancouver restaurants.
- [Vancouver Nature Guide: Guided Nature & Trail Experiences](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/work/vancouver-nature-guide-seo-dashboard): Help visitors discover Vancouver’s wildlife, forests and outdoor attractions with an experienced guide.

## Articles
- [How to Market a Restaurant Before It Opens: A Pre-Launch Playbook](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/blog/new-restaurant-marketing-vancouver): Pre-opening timeline, waitlists, Google Business Profile, behind-the-scenes content, soft openings, grand opening ideas, early reviews
- [7 Restaurant Marketing Tips from a Professional Cook Turned Marketer](https://misael-portfolio-plum.vercel.app/blog/restaurant-marketing-tips-vancouver): Google Business Profile, reviews, slow-night promotions, kitchen capacity, prep-time video content, menu descriptions, Vancouver seasonal planning
